name: followup
description: Follow-ups for a small business: finds overdue invoices, quiet quotes and unanswered customers from QuickBooks and mail, has Claude draft each follow-up for your review in a Follow-ups pane, and puts the ones you approve into Gmail as drafts. It never sends email and never changes QuickBooks: you press Send in Gmail.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds your follow-up workspace (followup.db, the spreadsheet, followup_mod/). Leave empty to use the folder Claude Code was started in. Run /followup setup to create it.
